title: Join two clips
description: Join clips with different dimensions into one 640 × 360 MP4.
notes: Video only: this recipe removes audio. Both clips are fitted into the same frame with black padding before joining. Use a separate audio workflow if you need a soundtrack.
prompt: Check my allowance. I authorize uploading first.mp4 and second.mp4 from my configured uploads folder. Join them in that order into one 640 × 360 MP4 without audio. Use the Join two clips recipe, keep one request_id for retries, track the job at most once per second, and save joined.mp4. Do not delete anything.

title: Add an image overlay
description: Place a small image or logo over a video and keep its audio when present.
notes: The image is scaled to 48 pixels wide and placed 8 pixels from the bottom-right corner. Adjust size/position for your video. No audio track is required; existing audio is re-encoded to AAC.
prompt: Check my allowance. I authorize uploading clip.mp4 and logo.png from my configured uploads folder. Use the Add an image overlay recipe: 48-pixel-wide logo, 8 pixels from the bottom-right, keeping existing audio if present. Keep one request_id for retries, track at most once per second, and save overlay.mp4. Do not delete anything.

title: Replace the soundtrack
description: Combine the video from one file with audio from another.
notes: The original soundtrack is removed. Short replacement audio is padded with silence; longer audio is cut at the end of the video. The output uses H.264 video and AAC audio.
prompt: Check my allowance. I authorize uploading clip.mp4 and soundtrack.wav from my configured uploads folder. Use the Replace the soundtrack recipe. Remove original audio, pad a short replacement with silence, and cut longer audio at the video's end. Keep one request_id for retries, track at most once per second, and save new-soundtrack.mp4. Do not delete anything.
